sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 300. Success value 100. 4x magic damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all allies. Applies Kismet.
-Target: all allies. Removes status ailments.
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical/magic damage taken to 0 (7 times). Effect applied for 30 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Grace for 70 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction, status ailments, and debuffs. After the effect ends, 100 Cost is restored to your character).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: yourself. Applies Protection for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; nullifies status ailments, debuffs, and buff removal effects. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
[Unison Effect Boost] Increases the Ability Power of the 300-Ability-Power attack that deals magic wind damage to all enemies 4 times with a success rate of 100 by 300.
Only [Total Defense] Heavenly Throne Maple can be used as Unlocking Potential material
